summary: The macOS app maintains an authoritative local projection of daemon sessions/workspaces by subscribing before listing, then applying ordered catalog events; lag or transport failure causes reconnect and full resynchronization.
trigger: AxoWorkbench starts catalog synchronization, or an existing subscription is lost or reports lag.

steps.action: Open a catalog-only subscription that excludes terminal output.
Renegotiate daemon capabilities, concurrently fetch session and workspace snapshots, normalize selection/layout and update local catalog projections.
Long-poll event batches; apply authoritative snapshots/removals and refetch workspace records on workspace changes; process relay status separately.

On lag or transport error, unsubscribe best-effort, show reconnecting state, exponentially back off within configured bounds, then subscribe and resynchronize; after three consecutive failures ask daemon controller to recheck health.
